Mean of the left and right sides of a bilateral measure

Source: R/visit.R
combine_bilateral.Rd

<ROOT>_L_<V> and <ROOT>_R_<V> give <ROOT>_<V>. If only one side is available its value is used (allow_one_side = TRUE).

Usage

combine_bilateral(
  df,
  roots,
  visits = c("V0", "V3"),
  sides = c("L", "R"),
  allow_one_side = TRUE,
  suffix_new = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A data frame.

roots

Root names of the bilateral measures.

visits

Visit suffixes.

sides

Side codes.

allow_one_side

Use the single available side when the other is missing.

suffix_new

Optional text appended to the root of the new columns.

Value

df with the new columns.

Examples

d <- combine_bilateral(cohort_sim, "PUT")
head(d[, c("PUT_L_V0", "PUT_R_V0", "PUT_V0")])
#>   PUT_L_V0 PUT_R_V0 PUT_V0
#> 1     4.05     3.74  3.895
#> 2     3.88     3.77  3.825
#> 3     4.52     4.50  4.510
#> 4     4.80     4.65  4.725
#> 5     5.05     5.32  5.185
#> 6     5.02     5.05  5.035
